title: WCLI-98 round-3 nits: proxy-* rule in ADR 0024, case-only rename test, comment widths, test comment timestamps
description: Nits from the round-3 confirmatory Opus review of ward-cli#215 at 63a2edf. Nit A, the frontmatter summary paraphrase under the 200-character ceiling, is accepted as is and needs no change. D: ADR 0024 should name the proxy-* prefix rule beside the refusedHeaderNames pointer, since the family is not in that Map. E: no test renames an ordinary header by case alone and expects re-approval. B: comment width at profile.ts:180, :217, :456 and :459. C: ruling timestamps in test comments at header-auth.test.ts:197, :662 and :779.
